events.on_any: DEFINE EVENT on_any ON doc WHEN true THEN (UPDATE $after.id SET touched = true), (CREATE audit_log SET note = 'any')
events.on_create: DEFINE EVENT on_create ON doc WHEN $event = 'CREATE' THEN (CREATE audit_log SET doc = $after.id)
events.on_status: DEFINE EVENT on_status ON doc ASYNC RETRY 3 MAXDEPTH 2 WHEN $before.status != $after.status THEN { CREATE audit_log SET doc = $after.id, note = string::concat($before.status, ' -> ', $after.status) } COMMENT 'status transitions'
